[Suggested upload date: 2026-03-24]

STATEMENT OF WORK SOW-001

Statement of Work SOW-001, issued under the Master Service Agreement between
Solstice Retail Group, Inc. and Cobalt Digital Solutions, LLC dated 2 March
2026.

1. SCOPE. Implementation of Cobalt's inventory-forecasting platform across
forty (40) Solstice retail locations.

2. DELIVERABLES AND TIMELINE.
D1 — Discovery and requirements documentation (Week 4)
D2 — Pilot deployment, five (5) stores (Week 10)
D3 — Full rollout, forty (40) stores (Week 22)
D4 — Hypercare support and handover (Week 26)

3. FEES. Fixed fee of USD 640,000, milestone-billed as follows: 20% upon D1
acceptance, 30% upon D2 acceptance, 40% upon D3 acceptance, 10% upon D4
completion.

4. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA. Pilot forecast accuracy must be within eight percent
(8%) Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) against actual pilot-period sales
data before proceeding to the D3 full-rollout gate.

5. PROJECT TEAM.
Solstice Project Manager: J. Alvarez
Cobalt Delivery Lead: R. Chen

This Statement of Work is governed by the terms of the Master Service
Agreement referenced above.
